## Pre-registration
- Prediction: accuracy [0.750, 0.756]
- Prediction: time [4.44, 4.50]
- Supports if: (H10.2) off-seed >= +0.08 pp vs the E100 pool in >= 2 processes (path length reproduces E104's gain at zero time).
- Refutes if: off-seed within +-0.05 pp.
On the tip E100: Muon lr x1.5 in the 16/24 px phases. Off-seed before launch (2 fresh processes, seeds 3-24): 0.75231
and 0.75255 vs E100 pool 0.75265 (paired -0.03 / -0.01 pp); losses finite.

## Contingencies
- If it lands in the predicted range: refuted; E104's gain is update count, not path length.
- If it moves the right way but less than predicted: n/a.
- If it moves the opposite way: n/a.
- If it crashes: unexpected.
